findings.location: alternatives[1].body & faqs[3].answer: "Its commission overview refers to separate rate pages rather than printing exact margin-rate or cash-APY percentages." / "Interactive Brokers does not print exact margin-rate percentages in its checked commission overview."
findings.issue: Contradicts fetched ibkr.txt (https://www.interactivebrokers.com/en/pricing/commissions-home.php), which prints headline USD rates directly on the overview page: "Earn USD 3.38% on uninvested cash. Margin loans start at USD 4.38%." (and "as low as 4.38%" / "up to USD 3.38%"), plus plan spread formulas in its comparison table (Lite: cash Benchmark minus 1.5%, margin Benchmark plus 2.5%; Pro: cash Benchmark minus 0.5%, margin starting at Benchmark plus 1.5%, with cash interest proportional below $100,000 NAV), while linking to separate pages only for full balance-tier tables.
findings.fix: In alternatives[1].body paragraph 3, replace that sentence with: "Its commissions overview advertises USD cash interest up to 3.38% (Benchmark minus 1.5% on Lite and minus 0.5% on Pro, proportional below $100,000 Net Asset Value (NAV)) and USD margin loans as low as 4.38% (Benchmark plus 2.5% on Lite; starting at Benchmark plus 1.5% on Pro), with full balance-tier tables on separate rate pages." In faqs[3].answer, replace the final sentence with: "Interactive Brokers' commissions overview lists USD margin loans as low as 4.38% (Benchmark plus 2.5% on Lite, or starting at Benchmark plus 1.5% on Pro), with full tier schedules on its separate margin page."

findings.location: alternatives[4].body: "Cryptocurrency costs 0.75% to open and 0.75% to close." and "The pricing page advertises one flat margin rate for new margin accounts or accounts bringing at least $25,000 in new assets. It does not itemize an exact base margin-rate table, an uninvested cash sweep APY or an IRA contribution match. Without those figures, a cash-yield or margin-interest total cannot be calculated from that page."
findings.issue: Two factual errors against fetched tastytrade.txt (https://tastytrade.com/pricing/): (1) lines 127-137 list standard Cryptocurrency at 1% per total purchase to open and 1% to close, while 0.75% open / 0.75% close applies only to Bitcoin and Ethereum ("Cryptocurrency (BTC/ETH)"); (2) lines 217-224 explicitly print "6.75% FLAT MARGIN RATE" ("Base Rate - 3.25%") across any margin balance size when opening a first tastytrade margin account or bringing $25,000+ in new assets.
findings.fix: In alternatives[4].body paragraph 2, change the crypto sentence to: "Cryptocurrency costs 1% to open and 1% to close, or 0.75% each way for Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH)." In paragraph 3, replace the first three sentences with: "The pricing page advertises a 6.75% flat margin rate (Base Rate minus 3.25%) across any balance size when you open a first tastytrade margin account or bring at least $25,000 in new assets. It does not itemize non-promotional margin tiers, an uninvested cash sweep APY or an IRA contribution match, so cash-yield and non-promotional margin totals cannot be calculated from that page."

findings.location: alternatives[5].body, chooseSection.body, verdict & faqs[0].answer / faqs[3].answer: "Its homepage also advertises 3.75% APY for higher-tier accounts or its $500,000-plus exclusive program." / "Its homepage does not publish futures trading commissions or advertise a 3% IRA contribution match." / "All seven brokerages list $0 online US stock and ETF commissions..." / "while Public lists a 5.15% base rate across balances."
findings.issue: Four discrepancies against public_com.txt and public_pricing.txt: (1) Public's nav lists "3.30% APY on your cash with no fees" (line 36) while the homepage hero displays "3.75% APY* on cash" / "High-Yield Cash Account 3.75% APY*" (lines 94, 105) with zero text tying 3.75% APY to higher-tier accounts or Public Concierge ($500,000+, lines 80-81, 189-196); (2) lines 43-44 and 110-111 explicitly advertise a 1% match on annual Traditional and Roth IRA contributions (and an uncapped 1% transfer match), which the "3%" wording obscures; (3) public_com.txt prints "no commissions" only under Trading API ("Program your trading with no commissions", line 23) and refers general stock/ETF commissions to Public's Fee Schedule; (4) lines 151-154 list "Base rate 5.15%" and "Lowest rate 4.20%", so 5.15% is the entry base tier rather than a flat rate across all balances (and similarly rows[0].pricing says "Margin starts at 5.25%" for Robinhood when 5.25% is the highest rate up to $50,000, stepping down to 4.20% at $50M+).
findings.fix: (1) In alternatives[5].body paragraph 1, replace sentence 2 with: "Public's site navigation lists 3.30% APY with no fees on its High-Yield Cash Account, while its homepage hero displays 3.75% APY* on cash and separately offers Public Concierge for accounts of $500,000 or more." (In paragraph 4, note the $330/$660 figures use the 3.30% rate, while 3.75% would yield $375 on $10,000.) (2) In alternatives[5].body paragraph 3, state: "Its homepage advertises a 1% annual IRA contribution match (and an uncapped 1% portfolio-transfer match) rather than Robinhood Gold's 3% match, and does not publish futures commissions." (3) In chooseSection.body, verdict, and faqs[0].answer, state that Robinhood and five alternatives publish $0 online US stock and ETF commissions while Public advertises commission-free API trading on its homepage. (4) In faqs[3].answer, change "across balances" to "(with lower tiers down to 4.20%)", and in rows[0].pricing change "Margin starts at 5.25%" to "Margin 5.25% up to $50,000 (down to 4.20% at $50M+)".

findings.location: alternatives[0].body: "Schwab lists $6.95 for online Over-The-Counter (OTC) equities and $50 for online foreign-stock transactions." and "Human-advisor programs have minimums ranging from $25,000 to $2,000,000, with listed starting advisory fees ranging from 0.40% to 0.95% by program."
findings.issue: Against schwab.txt: (1) Managed Account Select Equity Strategies ($100,000 minimum, lines 364-370) starts at 1.00%, not 0.95%, so published starting fees across Schwab's other managed/advisory programs run from 0.40% to 1.00% (while Schwab Advisor Network at $2,000,000 states advisor-set fees); (2) not all of those programs are "Human-advisor programs" (Schwab Personalized Indexing at 0.40% / $100,000 minimum is direct indexing); (3) lines 194-209 specify the $50 online fee applies to foreign-stock transactions placed on the US OTC market (online trades directly on foreign local exchanges are not available, and Canadian securities are $6.95 online).
findings.fix: In paragraph 2, write "$50 for online foreign-stock transactions on the US OTC market". In paragraph 3, rewrite the advisory sentence as: "Other managed and advisory programs carry minimums from $25,000 to $2,000,000, with listed starting fees from 0.40% (Schwab Personalized Indexing) to 1.00% (Managed Account Select Equity Strategies), or advisor-set fees through Schwab Advisor Network."
